premises.text: Fast-growing companies are sharing a large volume of pictures daily.
premises.evidence_span: One and a half million pictures are shared every day, such as this one.

premises.text: Finding pictures of interest is a challenge for users.
premises.evidence_span: The question is, how do you find pictures you like?

premises.text: Skyline organizes real-time photos similar to how Google organizes websites.
premises.evidence_span: Skyline organizes real-time photos. So we'll do real-time photos what Google did for websites.

premises.text: Interests can be based on people, things, or places.
premises.evidence_span: We really believe interests are more than just people. They can be something, someone, or somewhere.

premises.text: Skyline collects user interests from social networks.
premises.evidence_span: From Facebook, we collect the pages you have liked. From Twitter, we connect your safe searches and recently used hashtags.

premises.text: Skyline aggregates a large number of pictures from various services.
premises.evidence_span: we collect over a million pictures a day from services such as Instagram, TwitPic, and YFrog.

premises.text: Users can see a personalized stream of real-time photos.
premises.evidence_span: Matching your personal interest to that stream of real-time photos means everybody gets his own skyline.

premises.text: Skyline can be useful for current events and breaking news.
premises.evidence_span: We found that this is really useful for current events.

premises.text: Skyline is launching as both a website and mobile apps.
premises.evidence_span: We are not only launching this as a website, but also as an app, both on iPhone and on Android.

premises.text: Users can share photos on social networks or via email.
premises.evidence_span: You can also share the photo on your favorite social networks, Twitter and Facebook, or share it by email.

premises.text: Brands can target users based on their defined interests.
premises.evidence_span: Since users define their own interest, brands can target an interest, like TechCrunch Disrupt.

premises.text: Revenue can be generated through ads or monthly fees for an ad-free experience.
premises.evidence_span: They can revenue share on our ads, or pay us a monthly fee for an ad-free experience.

premises.text: Skyline's services are built on their own API.
premises.evidence_span: all our services are built on our own API.

value.text: Users can find and share real-time photos based on their interests.
value.evidence_span: Matching your personal interest to that stream of real-time photos means everybody gets his own skyline.
